Scamell was next for the Club, 15th, then came the versatile S L King, 25th, Carne 41st, and no others in the first 60. A total of the scores of the expected prominent Clubs showed Herne Hill with 66 points, Sheffield 75, Belgrave 82 and Surrey W C. 118, which seemed fairly satisfactory until it was…

Scammell, Elson, Field and Carne are to be congratulated on their fine performance, and most of us were especially pleased to see Jack Carne in the scoring four after so many disappointments in previous "Juniors."
McMullen, Dodkin, Cricton, Carne and Rathbone have already promised to be there, and they, with Green Rickards, and Manning, will make a redoubtable team.
Field (22nd) and Carne (24th). These were the happenings that stirred us ten years ago!
